events.verdict: Houstan (ORL) establishes himself in Johnson's (ATL) path and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick.
Young (ATL) reaches in for the ball and makes contact with Banchero's (ORL) arm, which affects his SQBR during his dribble on the perimeter.
Suggs (ORL) moves laterally into Young's (ATL) path and body contact occurs that affects Young's SQBR during the drive.
Anthony (ORL) aligns along Murray's (ATL) path and he absorbs the marginal contact during the drive.
Anthony (ORL) jumps into the air and turns his body into Murray (ATL), delivering contact after the release that affects Murray's ability to return to the floor normally.
Anthony (ORL) releases his pass and continues to, rather than through, Young's (ATL) space and the contact is marginal.
Johnson (ATL) moves into Anthony's (ORL) space and delivers contact that dislodges the defender during his pursuit of the loose ball.
Anthony (ORL) makes last contact with the ball prior to it bouncing out of bounds. Possession is properly awarded to Atlanta.
Capela (ATL) firms up in Anthony's (ORL) path and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the screen.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that shows Okeke (ORL) does not make last contact with the ball prior to it bouncing out of bounds. Possession is properly awarded to Atlanta.
Okeke (ORL) brings his hand to the ball and cleanly deflects it away from Young (ATL) during his dribble.
Capela (ATL) brings his left hand to the ball and cleanly deflects it away from Anthony (ORL) during his dribble drive.
Anthony (ORL) goes to the ground in pursuit of the loose ball and makes contact with Bey's (ATL) right arm and leg, which causes Bey to fall to the floor during the loose ball opportunity.
Houstan (ORL) is moving alongside Young's (ATL) path and marginal body contact occurs at the end of Young's drive.
Young (ATL) attempts to jump around Banchero (ORL), who is in a legal defensive position in Young's path, and marginal body contact occurs during the release of the pass.
Houstan (ORL) establishes himself in Johnson's (ATL) path and does not deliver illegal contact when setting the pick.
Capela (ATL) is in the paint for at or about three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Murray (ATL) avoids making contact with Houstan's (ORL) arm during his legal contest of the perimeter jump shot attempt.
Murray (ATL) brings his hand toward the ball and marginal brush contact occurs with Anthony's (ORL) arm.
Young (ATL) aligns along Anthony's (ORL) path and absorbs the marginal contact during the drive.
Anthony (ORL) brings two hands to the ball, ending his dribble, and then proceeds to resume dribbling shortly thereafter. Young (ATL) does not make contact with the ball.
Young (ATL) makes direct contact with the ball and cleanly blocks Anthony's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Anthony (ORL) goes to the ground in pursuit of the loose ball and avoids making illegal contact with Young (ATL), who also goes to the ground in pursuit of the loose ball.

Referees conducted a replay review of the offensive foul called on Banchero (ORL) because they were not reasonable certain whether Capela (ATL) was outside the restricted area at the time of contact. Upon review, referees determined that while Capela was outside the restricted area, he was sliding into Banchero's path at the time of contact and therefore not in a legal guarding position, which is a reviewable matter under the restricted area review trigger. A defensive non-shooting foul is attributed to Capela because the contact occurred during a pass and not a shot attempt.
Bitadze (ORL) uses his right hand to deflect the inbounds pass and then  gathers it with two hands. Bitadze then legally releases the ball and starts his dribble.
Bitadze (ORL) is actively guarding an opponent within three seconds of entering the lane.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Murray (ATL) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is properly awarded to Orlando.
Bitadze (ORL) momentarily grasps and releases Bey's (ATL) arm as the two players engage during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Houstan (ORL) aligns along Murray's (ATL) path after his gather and avoids making illegal contact with Murray during the driving shot attempt.

Murray (ATL) brings his hand toward the ball and lightly grazes Anthony's (ORL) head/face. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Young (ATL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Capela (ATL) is in the paint for at or about three seconds when he moves to imminently guard an opponent.
Johnson (ATL) reaches for the ball and makes contact with Anthony's (ORL) side, which affects his SQBR.
Following the rebound, Bogdanovic (ATL) reaches in for the ball and makes marginal contact with Bitadze's (ORL) arm.
